verses.translation: A Psalm for David, of Aggæus and Zacharias. I will give thee thanks, O Lord, with my whole heart; and I will sing psalms to thee before the angels; for thou hast heard all the words of my mouth.

translations.ron: Lăuda-Te-voi, Doamne, cu toată inima mea, că ai auzit cuvintele gurii mele şi înaintea îngerilor Îţi voi cânta.
translations.grk: Ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυὶδ, Ἀγγαίου καὶ Ζαχαρίου. Ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι Κύριε ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ μου, καὶ ἐναντίον ἀγγέλων ψαλῶ σοι, ὅτι ἤκουσας πάντα τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ στόματός μου.

verses.translation: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and give thanks to thy name, on account of thy mercy and thy truth; for thou hast magnified thy holy name above every thing.

translations.ron: Închina-mă-voi în locaşul Tău cel sfânt şi voi lăuda numele Tău, pentru mila Ta şi adevărul Tău; că ai mărit peste tot numele cel sfânt al Tău.
translations.grk: Προσκυνήσω πρὸς ναὸν ἅγιόν σου, καὶ ἐξομολογήσομαι τῷ ὀνόματί σου, ἐπὶ τῷ ἐλέει σου καὶ τῇ ἀληθείᾳ σου· ὅτι ἐμεγάλυνας ἐπὶ πᾶν τὸ ὄνομα τὸ ἅγιόν σου.

verses.translation: In whatsoever day I shall call upon thee, hear me speedily; thou shalt abundantly provide me with thy power in my soul.

translations.ron: În orice zi Te voi chema, degrabă mă auzi! Sporeşte în sufletul meu puterea.
translations.grk: Ἐν ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπικαλέσωμαί σε, ταχὺ ἐπάκουσόν μου· πολυωρήσεις με ἐν ψυχῇ μου δυνάμει σου.

verses.translation: Let all the kings of the earth, O Lord, give thanks unto thee; for they have heard all the words of thy mouth.

translations.ron: Să Te laude pe Tine, Doamne, toţi împăraţii pământului, când vor auzi toate graiurile gurii Tale,
translations.grk: Ἐξομολογησάσθωσάν σοι Κύριε πάντες οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς, ὅτι ἤκουσαν πάντα τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ στόματός σου.

verses.translation: And let them sing in the ways of the Lord; for great is the glory of the Lord.

translations.ron: Şi să cânte în căile Domnului, că mare este slava Domnului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ᾀσάτωσαν ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς Κυρίου, ὅτι μεγάλη ἡ δόξα Κυρίου.

verses.translation: For the Lord is high, and yet regards the lowly; and he knows high things from afar off.

translations.ron: Că înalt este Domnul şi spre cele smerite priveşte şi pe cele înalte de departe le cunoaşte.
translations.grk: Ὅτι ὑψηλὸς Κύριος, καὶ τὰ ταπεινὰ ἐφορᾷ, καὶ τὰ ὑψηλὰ ἀπομακρόθεν γινώσκει.

verses.translation: Though I should walk in the midst of affliction, thou wilt quicken me; thou hast stretched forth thine hands against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand has saved me.

translations.ron: De ajung la necaz, viază-mă! Împotriva vrăjmaşilor mei ai întins mâna Ta şi m-a izbăvit dreapta Ta.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν πορευθῶ ἐν μέσῳ θλίψεως, ζήσεις με· ἐπʼ ὀργὴν ἐχθρῶν μου ἐξέτεινας χεῖράς σου, καὶ ἔσωσέ με ἡ δεξιά σου.

verses.translation: O Lord, thou shalt recompense them on my behalf: thy mercy, O Lord, endures for ever: overlook not the works of thine hands.

translations.ron: Domnul le va plăti lor pentru mine. Doamne, mila Ta este în veac; lucrurile mâinilor Tale nu le trece cu vederea.
translations.grk: Κύριε ἀνταποδώσεις ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ· Κύριε τὸ ἔλεός σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν σου μὴ παρίδῃς.
